item.title: Privacy Policy
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Last updated: March 1, 2026

JMIT (“I”, “me”) operates jmit.ca and provides IT services. This policy explains what information I collect and how I use it.

What I Collect

  • Contact information you provide: name, email, phone number (optional), and details about your issue — submitted through the service request form or email.
  • Remote session data: During remote support sessions, I can see your screen. I do not record sessions, take screenshots, or store any of your personal files or data.
  • Payment information: e-Transfer payments are processed through Interac. I do not see or store your banking details.

What I Don’t Collect

  • I don’t use cookies for tracking or analytics.
  • I don’t sell, share, or give your information to third parties.
  • I don’t store passwords or credentials you share during a support session.

How I Use Your Information

  • To respond to your inquiry or service request.
  • To provide the service you’ve requested.
  • To send invoices and follow up on completed work.

That’s it.

Third-Party Services

  • Google Forms: The service request form is hosted by Google. Their privacy policy applies to form submissions.
  • RustDesk: Remote support sessions use RustDesk, connected through a server I operate. Session data passes through my server only during the active session and is not stored.

Data Retention

I keep your contact information and service history for bookkeeping and follow-up. If you want me to delete your information, email me at mail@jmit.ca and I will.

Contact

Questions about this policy: mail@jmit.ca

item.title: Common Questions
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Common Questions

What is Remote Support?

I connect to your computer using secure remote access software. You can see everything I’m doing on your screen. Most issues can be resolved this way, and we both get to stay home. 😉

Securty during Remote Sessions

I use industry-standard remote access tools. You can watch everything happening on screen, and you can disconnect the session at any time. I do not store any of your personal data.

What if your problem can’t be fixed remotely?

I offer in-home support in Haldimand and Norfolk County.

What payments do I accept?

Interac e-Transfer for all invoiced work. Cash is also accepted for in-home visits.

Do I work on Macs or other Apple products?

My focus is Windows and Linux systems. I have limited experience repairing and supporting Apple devices. If you have a Mac/Apple related question, feel free to reach out — I may still be able to help.

Do you sell computer parts?

For custom builds, I help you choose the right parts for your budget and build the system for you. You purchase the parts directly (I can send you the links), or I can order them on your behalf.

What are my hours of operation?

Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm. I respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours.

Where do you begin?

Fill out the Service Request Form, or email mail@jmit.ca. I’ll respond within 24 hours.

item.title: Terms of Service
item.author: Unknown
item.description:
Last updated: March 1, 2026

These terms apply when you use JMIT’s services. By requesting or receiving service, you agree to them.

Services

JMIT provides IT support, repair, malware remediation, and custom PC builds for home users and small businesses. Services are provided by me (James), operating as a sole proprietor in Ontario, Canada.

Quotes and Pricing

  • Current pricing is listed on the pricing page.
  • For hourly work, I’ll give you an estimate before starting. If the work looks like it will exceed the estimate, I’ll let you know before continuing.
  • Flat-rate services are priced as listed. No surprises.

Payment

  • Payment is due on completion of work.
  • Accepted methods: Interac e-Transfer (mail@jmit.ca), cash (in-home visits only).

Remote Support

  • Remote sessions require your consent. You can see everything happening on your screen and can disconnect at any time.
  • I do not access files, accounts, or data beyond what’s needed to resolve your issue.
  • I am not responsible for pre-existing issues discovered during a session.

In-Home Visits

  • In-home visits are available in Haldimand / Norfolk County.
  • You agree to provide a safe, accessible workspace.

Liability

  • I’ll do my best to fix your problem, but I can’t guarantee every issue is solvable.
  • I am not liable for data loss. Back up your data before any service. I’ll remind you, but the responsibility is yours.
  • My total liability for any service is limited to the amount you paid for that service.

Custom PC Builds

  • You purchase the parts (I can help you choose and order them).
  • The $150 labour fee covers assembly and initial setup.
  • Parts are covered by their manufacturer warranties, not by me.
  • I guarantee my assembly work — if something I built isn’t working right, I’ll fix it.

Cancellations

  • You can cancel scheduled work with no charge if you let me know at least 24 hours in advance.

Changes to These Terms

I may update these terms. The latest version is always available at jmit.ca/terms.

Contact

Questions: mail@jmit.ca
